D: Paddington and the Browns head to Peru to find Aunt Lucy, who has gone missing from the Home for Retired Bears.
P: Serve the marmalade sandwiches when Paddington pulls one from under his hat.
S: Grilled sandwiches of thick-cut marmalade, ham and cheddar

Thick white bread layered with sharp cheddar, ham and bitter orange marmalade, toasted in butter until golden and melting, cut into squares. Butter 8 slices of thick white bread on one side. On the unbuttered sides of 4 slices spread 1 tbsp thick-cut marmalade each, then add 150g sliced ham and 150g grated vintage cheddar. Close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into squares.
Lime and ají amarillo mashed potato layered with shredded chicken

Mashed yellow potato seasoned with lime and chilli paste, layered with chicken and avocado, cut into squares. Boil 800g potatoes, mash smooth with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste, 3 tbsp oil and salt. Mix 300g cooked shredded chicken breast with 3 tbsp mayonnaise. Layer potato, chicken, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.
Choclo with queso fresco and ají sauce
the corn of the Peruvian Andes

Fat corn cobs boiled and charred, served with slabs of grilled fresh white cheese and a creamy, mild yellow chilli and lime sauce. Boil 4 corn cobs (or Peruvian choclo if you can get it) for 8 minutes, then char on a hot grill pan for 4 minutes, turning. Slice 250g haloumi or queso fresco and grill 1 minute a side. Blend 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste with 100g feta, 80ml evaporated milk, 2 crackers and the juice of half a lime until smooth. Cut the cobs in thirds and serve with the cheese and sauce.
M: Wok-seared beef, red onion and tomato with soy, over crisp fries

Beef strips stir-fried with onion, tomato, soy and vinegar, tossed through chips, served with rice. Bake 500g frozen fries until crisp. Sear 600g sliced beef rump in a smoking wok, add 1 sliced red onion and 2 tomatoes in wedges, then 3 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp vinegar. Toss through the chips and serve with 300g cooked rice.
Ají de gallina with rice and egg
a creamy Peruvian chicken dish for the family

Shredded chicken in a creamy yellow chilli, walnut and parmesan sauce thickened with bread, over rice with boiled egg, black olives and a sprinkle of coriander. Poach 700g chicken breast in 1L stock for 15 minutes and shred, keeping the stock. Soak 3 slices of white bread in 250ml evaporated milk. Fry 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 3 tbsp ají amarillo paste and 1 tsp turmeric. Blend with the soaked bread and 50g walnuts, return to the pan with 300ml stock and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the chicken and 40g parmesan. Serve over rice with halved boiled eggs and olives.
W: Crumbly shortbread cookies sandwiched with dulce de leche
Soft, crumbly cornflour biscuits sandwiched with thick dulce de leche, then rolled around the edges in desiccated coconut.
K: Purple corn drink simmered with pineapple, cinnamon and clove
Purple corn simmered with pineapple, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened and served cold with lime.
